_doc: Kevin tire profiles: single source of truth (mirrored byte-identical in anglerdroid src/tire_profiles.json and kevin-urdf-twin simready/tire_profiles.json). Select with env KEVIN_TIRE=stock|soft_v3_2 (twin: also --tire flag / ?tire= URL param). Default stock until James confirms the soft tires are installed. See docs/tire_profiles.md.

stock.label: ODrive BotWheel stock rubber tire
stock.status: measured (twin geometry); robot_config keeps James's tape value 17.0 cm

soft_v3_2.label: KevinFlex soft over-tire v3.2 (95A TPU, 20 spokes)
soft_v3_2._mj_note: solref/solimp calibrated in kevin_full_soft: 3.8 mm static sink at 49 N/wheel = 12.9 N/mm, free R 103.8 -> loaded 100.0 mm; bounce ~7 Hz
soft_v3_2.status: NOMINAL design values - re-measure loaded radius (roll 10 turns) and ride height after install; friction unmeasured (stock value kept)
